entries.name: Missile
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent Unity 2D RPG sprite animation atlas. Use the supplied comparison sheet as exact approved character design and pixel style reference. Create ONLY the MISSILE female mage (leftmost purple hood mage) as a 1024x1024 transparent PNG sprite sheet. STRICT GRID: exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, each cell 256x256, no dividers or labels. Rows from top to bottom: walking toward camera FRONT/DOWN, walking screen LEFT in profile, walking screen RIGHT in profile, walking away BACK/UP. Columns are 4 consecutive clearly different walking phases: left foot forward, passing pose, right foot forward, passing pose. Feet alternate visibly; small sleeve/staff/robe bounce but same anatomy, head size and design across all 16 frames. Each whole character is centered within its cell, about 180-195 px tall, same ground baseline at 224 px down from each cell top, generous transparent gutters, nothing crosses cell boundaries. Side views opposite facing directions, back view shows back of hood. Match exact approved compact female face and proportions, lavender bangs inside rounded purple hood with gold fabric trim, navy tunic, short purple gold-trim cape with small gold cross on back, brown boots, brown staff with chunky teal square-cluster orb. The staff is always in SAME anatomical hand throughout views (do not change hands between rows); side directions may be mirrored. Crisp retro low-resolution square-cluster pixel art, approximately 40-48 logical pixels tall enlarged with nearest-neighbor; uniform pixel grain across skin, hood, clothes and weapon. No painting, no microdetails, no fine white veins, no blur or smooth antialiasing, no black heavy outlines, soft material-colored outlines, no glow/bloom, no shadows underneath, no effects. Fully transparent background alpha0, no checkerboard drawn into image, no text, no title, no other characters. Preserve the reference identity closely; this is a usable walk-cycle sheet.
